scripts.text: I heard that there are creeps there who won't get up at all even if it rains or snows, or their sweethearts or parents call them!
scripts.translation: 听说那里还有些怪人，不管下雨下雪，还是恋人、父母来叫，都不肯起来！

scripts.text: And that black clouds hover over them all the time, causing a storm!
scripts.translation: 他们头上还总是乌云密布，刮风下雨！

scripts.text: Search through the vegetable-shaped drawer to my right.
scripts.translation: 去翻翻我右边那个蔬菜形状的抽屉吧。

scripts.text: - You don't remember how to open the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你不记得怎么打开仓库了。 -

scripts.text: - The figure 1 0 0 is written in small letters on the vegetable-shaped drawer. -
scripts.translation: - 蔬菜形状的抽屉上用小字写着数字 1 0 0。 -

scripts.text: - You don't seem to have 100 zeny with you. -
- You gave up using the warehouse. -
